Adapt SettingsEditorContribution constructor/model-change refresh and _createPreferencesRenderer from preferences.contribution.ts. Use exact owned USER_LOCAL model references with stale/disposal fencing; retain UserSettingsRenderer separately and route diagnostics through the existing JSON provider.
